Reading the table

  • Each intrinsic shows its headline metric. The best of its seven accuracy columns is bold. Hover a cell for all its metrics, or for why it is empty.
  • granite-switch (vLLM): the adapters composed into the base model by each commit's composer, and served by its vLLM backend.
  • HF + PEFT: the same adapter checkpoints without granite-switch, loaded with Hugging Face transformers and PEFT. SR runs on a standalone Hugging Face implementation of the Shadow Residual model.
  • Base: the base model with no adapter. A final instruction tells it the answer format each scorer expects, which only the adapters were trained on.
  • Gain ratio: the share of an adapter's gain over the base model that granite-switch keeps. n/a: the adapter gains under 1 point under HF + PEFT, too little to divide by.
  • — no adapter or eval set for this cell; · not run; error the run failed. Greyed rows used an older benchmark version.
  • The i next to a commit opens its run details: library versions, GPU, the adapter checkpoints and the reference run.
  • Granite 4.2 prompts turn reasoning off and carry their documents as tool messages, the way its adapters were trained.

Adapters:

  • LoRA: LoRA (all-linear, r=16)
  • aLoRA: aLoRA (all-linear, r=32)
  • SR: Shadow Residual (q,o + MLP, r=32, cross r=32, shared KV)
